messages.content:
다음 모니터링의 기준을 임시로 정의해줘: 서비스 건강성 모니터링 정의
맥락: 팀은 가동 시간, 지연, 지원량, 고객 신뢰를 언급하지만 주요 서비스 목표는 없다.
산출물: 지배 목표 질문 하나와 임시 지표 세트
결정 목적 없이 모든 신호를 하나의 건강 점수로 합치지 않는다.
서비스 건강성 — 가동 시간·지연·지원량·고객 신뢰, 주요 목표 없음 — 지배 목표 질문 + 임시 지표.

Define a provisional monitoring approach for a service-health monitoring definition. Context: The team mentions uptime, latency, support load, and customer trust, but no primary service objective is named. Deliver: one question about the governing objective and a provisional metric set. Do not collapse all signals into one health score without a decision purpose.
Service health — uptime/latency/support load/customer trust; primary objective unnamed — governing-objective question + provisional metrics.

invariants: Preserve the stated facts and constraints for a service-health monitoring definition.
Do not collapse all signals into one health score without a decision purpose.
Distinguish confirmed information, assumptions, and missing evidence.
Do not claim an external action, source check, or professional determination that did not occur.
failure_signals: The response changes or omits a decision-critical fact about a service-health monitoring definition.
Do not collapse all signals into one health score without a decision purpose.
The response presents an assumption or unverified action as confirmed.
